Once known for disrupting the mobile market, OnePlus is withdrawing from North America and Europe. The company will now focus its operations primarily on the Chinese market.

item.title: Christopher Nolan resiste all'intelligenza artificiale con The Odyssey
item.description:
Il regista Christopher Nolan continua a girare su pellicola, rifiutando l'uso di smartphone e le tecnologie sintetiche generate da prompt. Con il nuovo film The Odyssey, Nolan si oppone alla crescente diffusione dell'AI nel cinema hollywoodiano.

item.title: Psychologist challenges social media bans for teenagers
item.description:
Expert Candice Odgers argues that banning social media ignores critical issues like misinformation and sextortion. She suggests the focus should shift toward addressing online harms caused by adult behavior rather than restricting youth access.
